questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design practical backup integrity workflow with AWS services and minimal IaC.

## Key Concepts

- AWS Backup plan
- S3 object checksums
- Lambda event-driven automation
- DynamoDB manifests
- CloudWatch alerts

## Code Example

```yaml
Resources:
  SAPBackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: "backup.amazonaws.com" }
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPBackupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::sap-backups/*"

  SAPBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: "SAP-HANA-Backup-Plan"
        Rules:
          - RuleName: "DailyBackup"
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 2 * * ? *)"
            TargetBackupVault: "SAPBackups"
```

```yaml
  SAPBackupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: "lambda.amazonaws.com" }
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPBackupLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::sap-backups/*"
```

## Why This Is Asked
 DR readiness across regions is critical for SAP workloads. This tests automation, cross-region replication, and coordinated SAP+AWS failover with measurable RPO/RTO, not just theory.

## Key Concepts
 - SAP HANA System Replication across regions
 - SAP NetWeaver failover orchestration
 - DR tooling: EventBridge, Step Functions, Route53 failover, CloudWatch
 - RPO/RTO measurement and rollback safety
 - Minimal IaC for test endpoints

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  DRTestEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceType: t3.medium
      ImageId: ami-placeholder
  DRTestRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      Name: dr-test.example.com.
      Type: A
      SetIdentifier: DRTestEndpoint
      Failover: SECONDARY
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords:
        - !GetAtt DRTestEndpoint.PublicIp
      HealthCheckId: !Ref DRTestHealthCheck
  DRTestHealthCheck:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthThreshold: 1
      Type: HTTP
      FullyQualifiedDomainName: dr-test.example.com
      RequestInterval: 30
```

- How would you extend this to validate SAP data integrity post-failover?
- What metrics would you surface to alert on an unsuccessful DR test?

## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- Cross-account IAM roles
- Kinesis Firehose delivery to S3
- SAP audit log formats
- S3 Object Lock governance

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  CentralLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: sap-audit-central
      ObjectLockConfiguration:
        ObjectLockEnabled: ENABLED
        Rule:
          DefaultRetention:
            Days: 30
  LogDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
          Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: FirehosePut
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: arn:aws:s3:::sap-audit-central/*
  FirehoseDeliveryStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: sap-audit-stream
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt CentralLogBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt LogDeliveryRole.Arn
```
